summary: Femasys Inc. filed an 8-K on June 24, 2026, reporting receipt of a Nasdaq notice confirming the company regained compliance with the minimum bid price rule (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company had earlier received a deficiency notice on July 16, 2025, and subsequently effected a 1-for-20 reverse stock split on June 5, 2026, which brought the bid price above $1.00 for at least 10 consecutive business days. This filing is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No transaction or event triggering a special-situation classification is present.
